description: Upload limits (ADR-161). POST /api/v1/users/me/avatar with a 3 MB PNG-magic body: before PR-3 the axum router's 2 MB default body limit 413'd it; after PR-3 the route's handler cap (5 MB) governs and the avatar is stored (200). The same proof for the sidecar audio routes is the 3 MB audio body reaching the mock sidecar (wave9_pr3.rs).

expected.note: a 6 MB body would instead 413 with the handler's avatar_too_large, not the router default

request.body: <3 MB file field starting with PNG magic bytes>
